post.description:
Upload Breakpad symbol files to allow symbolicate stacktraces within minidump files (generated when using Electron, Breakpad or Crashpad) to show human-readable stacktraces in your dashboard.
If your application uses native libraries (aside from Electron and its helper libraries), you will need to generate and upload symbol files for each library and platform supported to see full stacktraces for native crashes.

parameters.description: The root path of the project on the filesystem where the application was built.

post.description: Upload dSYM files to show human-readable function names, file paths, and line numbers in your stacktraces on iOS, macOS and other Apple platforms.

dsym.description:
The dSYM to upload as a [form-data](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIME#Form-Data) file upload. Can be either:
A single dSYM binary file (within a `.dSYM` directory, the binary is located in `Contents/Resources/DWARF` and generally has the same base name as the .dSYM file itself); or
an archive (`.zip`) containing multiple `.dSYM` directories (as downloaded from App Store Connect).

apiKey.description: The API key for the application's project in BugSnag.

overwrite.description: Whether to ignore and overwrite existing uploads with same identifier, rather than failing if a matching file exists. (Default: `true`)

projectRoot.description: The root path of the project on the filesystem where the application was built. This is used to strip part of the path from the beginning of source file names in your dashboard.

400.description: A required parameter is missing or the file format is invalid

post.description:
For Android applications, when native code is used it will be compiled into shared object files, usually with the symbol names removed.
In order to replace the obfuscated data with a human-readable stacktrace, a shared object (`.so`) file containing those symbols is required.
This API relies on a build identifier generated by the NDK toolchain, see our docs for guidance on compatibility.

sharedObjectName.description: The name of the shared object that the symbols are for.

post.description:
If you use a tool to minify and optimize your application you will need to upload a mapping file to see full debugging information in error reports including the original class and method names.
Mapping files generated by [ProGuard](https://developer.android.com/studio/build/shrink-code.html), [DexGuard](https://www.guardsquare.com/dexguard) and [R8](https://r8.googlesource.com/r8#d8-dexer-and-r8-shrinker) are supported.

proguard.description: The ProGuard, DexGuard or R8 mapping file to upload as a [form-data](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIME#Form-Data) file upload.

apiKey.description: The API key for the application's project in BugSnag.

appId.description: A unique application ID, usually the package name, of the application.

versionCode.description: The version code of this build of the application.

buildUUID.description:
A unique identifier for this build of the application.
This is only required if you have multiple mapping files with the same appId and versionCode. This same ID must also be set in the BugSnag configuration in your app, so that errors match the uploaded build.

overwrite.description: Whether to ignore and overwrite existing uploads with same identifier, rather than failing if a matching file exists. (Default: `true`)

400.description: A required parameter is missing or the file format is invalid

409.description: Duplicate file already exists with the same identifier (use `overwrite` to replace)

schema.example: duplicate proguard file for <app ID> versionCode=<versionCode>

422.description: Nothing to upload (e.g. empty file or not uploaded correctly)

post.description: Upload JavaScript source map files to de-obfuscate bundled code in your React Native application and show human-readable stacktraces on your dashboard.

requestBody.description: One or more of `appVersion`, `appBundleVersion`/`appVersionCode` and `codeBundleId` is required to uniquely identify the uploaded file and allow it to be matched to events from your application.

bundle.description: The bundled JavaScript file to upload as a [form-data](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIME#Form-Data) file upload.

sourceMap.description: The source map file to upload as a [form-data](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIME#Form-Data).

apiKey.description: The API key for the application's project in BugSnag.

appBundleVersion.description: The bundle version (`CFBundleVersion`) of this build of the application (iOS only).

appVersionCode.description: The version code of this build of the application (Android only).

codeBundleId.description:
A unique identifier for the JavaScript bundle.
If you use deployment tools to update your JavaScript bundle without changing the native version or build number, use this ID to uniquely identify the update.
This same ID must also be set in the configuration in your app, so that errors match the uploaded bundle.

dev.description: Indicates whether the application is a debug or release build. This value should mirror the value used when generating source map files (Default: `false`).

overwrite.description: Whether to ignore and overwrite existing uploads with same identifier, rather than failing if a matching file exists. (Default: `true`)

projectRoot.description: The root path of the project on the filesystem where the application was built. This is used to strip part of the path from the beginning of source file names in your dashboard.

Conflicting identifiers provided with co.value: <version type> cannot be provided if 'codeBundleId' set

Conflicting identifiers provided for pla.value: '<version type>' should only be specified for <platform> platforms

No identifiers provided.value: at least one of 'appVersion', 'appVersionCode', 'appBundleVersion', or 'codeBundleId' must be provided

409.description: Duplicate file already exists with the same identifier (use `overwrite` to replace)

schema.example: duplicate source map file for <version details>

422.description: Nothing to upload (e.g. empty file or not uploaded correctly)

<source>.description:
The source of each source file referenced by the source map.
The field name `<source>` should be the URL used to access the file, and the value should be the source file contents.
Asterisks in the field name can be used as a wildcard.

post.description: Upload the generated line mappings file (`LineNumberMappings.json`) for Unity apps built with IL2CPP to allow C# line numbers to be displayed for iOS and Android apps.

mappingFile.description:
The line number mappings to upload as a [form-data](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIME#Form-Data) file upload.

Can be either:
A single `LineNumberMappings.json` file (generated by the IL2CPP tool when using the `--emit-source-mapping` option); or
a gzip compressed version of the file.

apiKey.description: The API key for the application's project in BugSnag.

dsymUUID.description: The UUIDs of the dSYMs for the builds that this mapping file applies to. Multiple UUIDs can be provided by repeating the form field. At least one of dsymUUID or soBuildId must be provided.

soBuildId.description: The build ID of the shared object file (.so) for the builds that this mapping file applies to. Multiple build IDs can be provided by repeating the form field. At least one of dsymUUID or soBuildId must be provided.

appId.description: A unique application ID, usually the package name, of the application (application ID on Android or bundle ID on iOS).

projectRoot.description: The root path of the project on the filesystem where the source files lie. This will be stripped off from the file name in the displayed stacktraces and improves error grouping.

overwrite.description:
If `true`, and one or more of the provided `dsymUUID` or `soBuildId` are already associated with a different line mappings file, they will be associated with this line mappings file instead.

If `false`, and one or more of the provided `dsymUUID` or `soBuildId` are already associated with a different line mappings file, the request will be rejected with a `409` error.

Note: if the same line mappings file has already been uploaded, any of the provided `dsymUUID` or `soBuildId` that are not already associated will be associated with the line mappings file, regardless of the `overwrite` flag.

400.description: A required parameter is missing or the file format is invalid

Missing dSYM UUID and SO build ID.value: missing required param: at least one of dsymUUID or soBuildId must be provided

401.description: Indicates that the provided apiKey doesn’t correspond to a BugSnag project

409.description: One or more of the provided `dsymUUID`s or `soBuildId`s are already associated with a different line mappings file (use `overwrite` to replace)

schema.example: Unity line mapping already exists for one or more of the supplied dSYM or shared object IDs

422.description: Indicates that the uploaded file is empty
